import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_completed_square_equal_iff
    (a c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, f x = f y ↔ x = y ∨ x + y = 2 * a := by
  intro x y
  constructor
  · 
    intro h
    have h₁ : f x = f y := h
    have h₂ : (x - a)^2 + c = (y - a)^2 + c := by
      rw [hf, hf] at h₁
      exact h₁
    have h₃ : (x - a)^2 = (y - a)^2 := by
      linarith
    have h₄ : x - a = y - a ∨ x - a = -(y - a) := by
      apply or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr
      intro h₅
      apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr h₅)
      nlinarith
    cases h₄ with
    | inl h₄ =>
      
      have h₅ : x = y := by linarith
      exact Or.inl h₅
    | inr h₄ =>
      
      have h₅ : x + y = 2 * a := by linarith
      exact Or.inr h₅
  · 
    intro h
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      
      rw [hf, hf, h]
      <;> ring
      <;> simp_all
      <;> ring
    | inr h =>
      
      have h₁ : f x = f y := by
        rw [hf, hf]
        have h₂ : x + y = 2 * a := h
        have h₃ : y = 2 * a - x := by linarith
        rw [h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> nlinarith
      exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem quadratic_completed_square_equal_iff
    (a c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = (x - a)^2 + c) :
    ∀ x y : ℝ, f x = f y ↔ x = y ∨ x + y = 2 * a := by
  simp (config := { contextual := true }) [hf]
  intro x y <;> rw [sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg] <;> ring
  first | rw [eq_comm] | ring
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ by
    cases' h with h h <;> [left; right] <;> linarith,
    fun h ↦ by
      cases' h with h h <;> [left; right] <;> linarith⟩
